title: Camera Safety Area and Camera Dynamics for Top-Down Games
description: A top-down action game's camera usually has a fixed angle and distance, which falls short in boss fights and big set pieces. Two POV corrections inserted in the PlayerCameraManager: a safe frame that pulls back automatically, and additive camera moves described by curve assets.

title: Niagara as an AnimNotifyState: Effects That Follow Attack Animations, and the SetUsingAbsoluteLocation Gotcha
description: Slash and trail effects on attack animations often need to follow the weapon at first and then stay behind when they end. How to wrap Niagara in an AnimNotifyState, and the UpdateComponentToWorld gotcha I hit when stopping the follow midway.

title: Axis-Snap Movement for Top-Down Games: Letting the Keyboard Follow the Stairs
description: In a top-down game, the keyboard can only input 8 directions (up, down, left, right and 4 diagonals). When a diagonal staircase, a narrow bridge or a winding walkway doesn't line up with any of those 8 directions...

title: UPROPERTY / UFUNCTION Specifier Cheat Sheet
description: The UPROPERTY and UFUNCTION specifiers I use most in UE C++, and how they differ when exposed to Blueprint.

title: GAS Basics: Should the ASC Live on the Pawn or the PlayerState?
description: The most common choice when setting up the Gameplay Ability System: which actor owns the AbilitySystemComponent, and when to call InitAbilityActorInfo.
